rfp_requirements.title: Describe scope of cybersecurity liability insurance coverage
rfp_requirements.description: If the organization has purchased cybersecurity liability insurance, describe in detail the scope of the coverage.

rfp_requirements.title: Indemnify for injury, loss of life, or property damage
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall indemnify the State for loss of life, property, or injury/damage to person, body, or property arising from or resulting directly or indirectly from the work and/or products supplied under the Contract or order.

rfp_requirements.title: Secure and maintain insurance for contract term
Provide Automobile Liability covering any automobile used
Auto Liability limits $1,000,000 combined single limit
Name State as Additional Insured on Auto Liability when applicable
Provide Workers' Compensation and Employers Liability Insurance
Indemnify for loss of life or property
rfp_requirements.description: Indemnification applies to loss of life, tangible property, or injury/damage to person or property arising from work/products supplied under the Contract.

rfp_requirements.title: Indemnify for Breach of Security from encryption failure
rfp_requirements.description: Indemnification applies to Breach of Security resulting from Contractor's breach of its obligation to encrypt Personal Data or otherwise prevent its release or misuse.

rfp_requirements.title: Indemnification is in addition to insurance obligations
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor's indemnification and liability under Section 4.1(A)(1) is not limited by, but is in addition to, the insurance obligations contained in Section 4.2 of the State Standard Terms and Conditions.

rfp_requirements.title: Contractor relieved of IP indemnification where claim arises solely from State actions
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor will be relieved of its IP indemnification responsibilities under Section 4.1(A)(1)(i), (ii), and (iii) for any claims made by an unaffiliated third party that arise solely from the actions or omissions of the State, its officers, employees or agents.

rfp_requirements.title: State will not indemnify Contractor; claim payment conditions
rfp_requirements.description: The State of New Jersey will not indemnify, defend, or hold harmless the Contractor. The State will not pay or reimburse for claims absent compliance with Section 4.1(B) and a determination by the State to pay the claim or a final order of a court of competent jurisdiction.

rfp_requirements.title: Contractor relief for State-caused claims
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor is relieved of its indemnification responsibilities under Subsection A for any third-party claims that arise solely from the actions or omissions of the State, its officers, employees, or agents.

rfp_requirements.title: State notice obligation for indemnified claims
rfp_requirements.description: The State will promptly notify Contractor in writing of the claim or suit (State obligation related to Contractor's indemnification duties).

rfp_requirements.title: Promptly notify Contractor of claim or suit
rfp_requirements.description: The State will promptly notify Contractor in writing of any claim or suit subject to indemnification.

rfp_requirements.title: State will not indemnify, defend, or hold Contractor harmless
rfp_requirements.description: The State of New Jersey will not indemnify, defend, pay or reimburse for claims on behalf of Contractor, and will not indemnify, defend or hold harmless the Contractor. The State will not pay or reimburse claims absent compliance with Section E and either a State determination to pay or a final orde

rfp_requirements.title: Indemnification in addition to insurance and other obligations
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor's indemnification and liability under Subsection A is not limited by but is in addition to the insurance obligations, and does not limit Contractor's other obligations under the Contract or the State's other remedies. State approval of work does not limit Contractor's obligations.

rfp_requirements.title: Appendix B referenced for Aetna HMO offset recipients
rfp_requirements.description: Appendix B identifies the specific Employees who were enrolled in the 2013 Aetna HMO option and qualify for the 2014 higher-contribution offset payment.

rfp_requirements.title: Union to defend and indemnify Employer
rfp_requirements.description: The Union will defend any claims, actions or proceedings brought against the Employer and indemnify and hold the Employer harmless from any recovery of damages under this Article.

rfp_requirements.title: Union to defend/indemnify Employer for check-off actions
rfp_requirements.description: The Union will defend any claims, actions or proceedings brought against the Employer (other than those brought by the Union), and indemnify and hold the Employer harmless for actions taken under this Article.
